sm_top.sm: The United States evacuated B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in the United Kingdom.
Houthi missile attacks targeted the presidential palace and airport complex in Aden, resulting in multiple explosions and casualties.
Saudi Arabia evacuated skyscraper staff home due to Houthi threats.
An oil tanker caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz following an incident.
The IRGC Navy stated that an oil tanker was struck by a mine in the Strait of Hormuz.
Satellite images show the aftermath of drone strikes on St. Petersburg and Leningrad.
A Houthi attack on a military camp in Yemen killed at least 53 people and injured over 200.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted incoming drones and missiles over Saudi Arabia and the Red Sea.
President Zelenskiy stated that Ukraine received no warning as Russia launched a major attack.
Airstrikes near the Sudan-Egypt border killed 72 gold miners.
A tugboat was struck off the coast of the UAE, leaving one person injured.
Reports state the US failed to warn Ukraine about a Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv.
Romanian fighter jets shot down drones over territorial waters.
A Saudi airstrike on a civilian home in Saada Province, Yemen, killed 10 people, including seven children.
A Houthi strike hit southern Saudi Arabia, injuring six people.
Houthis struck Saudi oil giant Aramco, prompting regional tensions and threats of escalation.
Relief agencies and the ICRC report mounting pressure on Yemen's health system and widespread displacement as fighting intensifies.
A Houthi missile attack on a military camp in Yemen killed at least 53 people.
Satellite images show Russia built a major new drone attack base in six weeks.
Russian missile and drone strikes hit Kyiv, damaging facilities and causing casualties.
Poland scrambled aircraft as Russia launched strikes on Ukraine.
Restrictions were announced at Moscow airports as Ukrainian drone attacks closed the sky over Moscow.
Drone strikes across Sudan reportedly killed more than 100 people.
Human Rights Watch reported that Mali's military and Russian backers committed abuses against civilians, including drone strikes that killed 94 people.
The Sudanese army carried out airstrikes inflicting heavy losses on the RSF in Nyala, according to regional government reports.
A Houthi missile attack on Yemen's presidential palace in Aden killed 5 people and injured 16 others, alongside other military camp strikes.
Russian forces captured Dobropillya in the Donetsk People's Republic.
Saudi airstrikes caused civilian casualties in Yemen over a 24-hour period.
The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps conducted military exercises involving ballistic missile test launches in Iran.
President Zelenskyy stated that Russia attacked Ukrainian energy infrastructure multiple times following a truce announcement.
Sudan drone attacks killed three children in Khartoum and dozens of civilians in Kordofan.
President Zelenskyy stated that Russia hit Ukraine's power grid again without early warning.
A drone strike near a market and transport hub in West Kordofan killed 80 people.
Asharq Al-Awsat reports a Russian attack caused destruction in Kyiv.
The Russian Ministry of Defense reported that 149 Ukrainian drones were shot down overnight.
Russia pounds Kyiv with strikes as US Senator Rubio urges Ukraine's Zelensky to focus on ending the war.
Saudi warplanes launched 110 strikes on Sanaa, killing and injuring over 30 people.
Ukrainian forces struck the Roboavia drone manufacturing facility in Russia's Rostov Region.
The Russian MoD claimed a drone strike hit a dry cargo ship carrying military and dual-use goods 50 km southwest of Odesa port.
Russian forces launched an attack on Rivne, causing fires to break out.
